description: Compare source readings. Default mode returns latest IMF, World Bank and UN readings with their own years. For the 20-economy, 10-concept research pilot, provide country_id and year (exact year or common) to compare IMF and World Bank in the same period, inspect definition mismatches and retrieve recorded-state provenance. Optional as_of and revision pin SOTW stored state, not publisher availability.

as_of.description: Optional SOTW recording cutoff: date at UTC midnight or ISO timestamp with timezone. Publisher availability is not established.

country_id.description: Optional ISO3 code to return a single country instead of all

indicator_id.description: Concept key, e.g. IMF.NGDPD (GDP), IMF.NGDPDPC (GDP per capita), IMF.NGDP_RPCH (real growth)

revision.description: Archive transaction watermark returned by an earlier comparison. Requires as_of.

year.description: Opt into the research pilot: exact year or latest common past year. Requires country_id.

name: compare_sources
